nodes.label: Botato
nodes.rationale: Personal Discord bot for a private guild; modular capabilities with voice music playback. Avoid calling it 'the bot' when naming the product, or 'music bot' (music is one capability).

nodes.label: Feature module
nodes.rationale: In-repo unit of bot capability (commands, listeners, related services) addable without changing the core process model. Avoid 'plugin' (reserved for runtime-loaded extensions), 'package', 'cog'.

nodes.label: Music node
nodes.rationale: Separate process that resolves media sources and streams audio into Discord voice on Botato's behalf. Avoid naming it Lavalink (implementation), music bot, or audio server.

nodes.label: Music session
nodes.rationale: Playback state for one guild's active voice listening (queue, now playing, control surface). Exists only while Botato can use a reachable music node; if the node is lost, the session ends. Avoid equating with queue alone, player, or paused-for-reconnect session.

nodes.label: Tier 1 local development
nodes.rationale: Default loop: run Botato on the host and the music node via Compose. Containerizing Botato is not the default for day-to-day development.

nodes.label: Tier 2 container smoke
nodes.rationale: Optional: run Botato in a container beside the Compose music node for image/container smoke — not the default day-to-day loop.

nodes.label: Single-token concurrency
nodes.rationale: Local and production share one Discord application token; do not run host Botato and cluster Botato with that token at the same time.

nodes.label: ghcr.io/adryan30/botato
nodes.rationale: linux/arm64 bot image published with sha-<full-git-sha> and semver tags; never publishes latest. Pin Argo to digest or immutable SHA/semver tag.

nodes.label: release-please
nodes.rationale: Opens/updates Release PR on main from Conventional Commits; merge bumps package.json/CHANGELOG, creates v* tag, and chains image publish because GITHUB_TOKEN tag pushes do not start other workflows.

nodes.label: Deploy contract Argo handoff
nodes.rationale: In-repo contract for cluster wiring in adryan30/infra — do not apply Argo/ESO/Vault from this repository.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 Sapphire application framework
nodes.rationale: Standardize on @sapphire/framework 5.x with plugin-logger, plugin-hmr (dev only), plugin-subcommands. Rejected thin DIY discord.js (owns routing forever), discordx (weaker piece modularity), Necord (Nest tax disproportionate).

nodes.label: Deferred Sapphire plugins
nodes.rationale: i18next, scheduled-tasks, api, editable-commands, pattern-commands, utilities-store stay out until a feature needs them.

nodes.label: Lavalink v4 music node
nodes.rationale: Lavalink ≥ 4.2 with youtube-source only as the music node implementation; cluster-internal (localhost in Compose). Alternatives NodeLink/Sonata declined for earlier ecosystem vs Lavalink plugin + multi-arch story.

nodes.label: Shoukaku + Kazagumo clients
nodes.rationale: DAVE-capable TypeScript clients chosen for the common discord.js pairing over other clients like lavalink-client or Moonlink.js.

nodes.label: YouTube-only v1 source policy
nodes.rationale: LavaSrc and Spotify resolve-to-playable removed from day-one stack: Spotify Web API Development Mode needs Premium-owned app; owner will not pay for Premium solely to resolve links. /play with Spotify URL must fail with clear unsupported reply.

nodes.label: ADR 0003 feature-module layout
nodes.rationale: Each feature at src/features/<name>/ with Sapphire piece folders; explicit stores.registerPath; no runtime plugin loading. Core stays thin; music as features/music with Shoukaku/Kazagumo and music-session under lib/.

nodes.label: stores.registerPath registration
nodes.rationale: Explicit path registration instead of mandatory auto-scan of all features or runtime plugin loading.

nodes.label: ADR 0004 image publish and Argo wiring
nodes.rationale: Two workloads on shardblade-001; linux/arm64 bot image to GHCR via Actions; official Lavalink image for music node; bjw-s app-template Argo Application named botato in namespace discord replacing discord-music.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004 image publish and argo wiring

nodes.label: Argo Application botato
nodes.rationale: bjw-s app-template Application in namespace discord with controllers bot and lavalink, Istio injection, ESO+Vault secrets. Replaces commented-out discord-music; do not revive that name.

nodes.label: ESO + Vault secrets
nodes.rationale: Discord token, Lavalink password, optional YouTube OAuth/poToken in cluster; no Spotify secrets. Local development does not require Vault/ESO.

nodes.label: Music node degraded operation
nodes.rationale: Music is a degradable capability, not a process dependency. MUSIC_NODE_* required at boot but down/late node yields degraded music with Botato-owned indefinite reconnect (re-add Shoukaku node — not reconnectTries Infinity due to stale connect error). Mid-play node loss ends music session; no auto-resume across node death in v1.

nodes.label: Music unavailable presence warning
nodes.rationale: Discord presence shows warning only while degraded; cleared when healthy; no channel announcements on loss or recovery.

nodes.label: Domain docs consumption
nodes.rationale: Before exploring, read CONTEXT.md (or CONTEXT-MAP.md) and relevant docs/adr/. Use glossary vocabulary; flag ADR conflicts explicitly.

nodes.label: main PR-only protection
nodes.rationale: main is protected; pushes must go through a pull request. Head branches deleted automatically on merge.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Commitizen via pnpm commit; Lefthook commit-msg hook runs commitlint so non-conforming messages are rejected.

nodes.label: GitHub Issues tracker
nodes.rationale: Issues and PRDs live as GitHub issues via gh CLI. PRs as request surface: no.

nodes.label: Wayfinder map issue
nodes.rationale: Single issue labelled wayfinder:map with child sub-issues; blocking via native issue dependencies; frontier query drops open blockers and assignees.

nodes.label: Publish Botato image workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds linux/arm64, pushes ghcr.io/adryan30/botato with sha- and optional semver from tag or workflow_call git_tag; latest=false for Argo story.

nodes.label: publish-image workflow_call git_tag
nodes.rationale: Optional v* tag input when chained from release-please because GITHUB_TOKEN tag pushes do not start this workflow.

nodes.label: release-please publish-image job
nodes.rationale: Calls publish-image.yml with tag_name when release_created is true.

nodes.label: Compose music-node service
nodes.rationale: Tier-1 local music node only using ghcr.io/lavalink-devs/lavalink:4.2.2-alpine; Botato runs on host — no bot service here.

nodes.label: Compose tier-2 botato service
nodes.rationale: Builds Dockerfile image botato:local; MUSIC_NODE_HOST=music-node; depends_on music-node healthy.

nodes.label: Lavalink youtube-plugin config
nodes.rationale: dev.lavalink.youtube:youtube-plugin:1.18.1; built-in youtube source disabled; OAuth TV client for age-gated; pot token/visitorData from env.
